title: The Olympic Gold Medal Lie 🥇 #shorts #sports #olympics
description: An Olympic gold medal is almost entirely a lie. Here is what Olympic gold medals are actually made of. #shorts #olympics #sportsfacts #athletics
text: An Olympic gold medal is almost entirely a lie. The last time the Olympics awarded solid gold medals was all the way back in 1912. Today, an Olympic gold medal is actually made of over ninety-two percent silver and is merely plated with six grams of pure twenty-four karat gold. title: The Hidden Ocean Wires Powering The World 🌐 #shorts #technology #tech
description: 99% of internet traffic doesn't travel through satellites. It travels through tiny glass wires on the ocean floor. #shorts #internet #cyber #science
text: Ninety-nine percent of people think the internet is powered by satellites in space, but they are completely wrong. Nearly all global internet traffic travels through fiber-optic cables resting on the pitch-black floor of the ocean. These fragile cables are no thicker than a garden hose, span over eight hundred thousand miles across oceanic trenches, and transmit trillions of dollars in financial transactions every second. title: The Gym Calorie Burn Illusion 🏃‍♂️ #shorts #fitness #fatloss
description: Your hour in the gym only accounts for 5% of the calories you burn daily. Here is the real secret to fat loss. #shorts #workout #health #weightloss
text: Spending an hour in the gym only accounts for about five percent of the total calories you burn each day. Most people think grueling workouts are the main driver of fat loss, but the real calorie-burning machine is NEAT: Non-Exercise Activity Thermogenesis. Fidgeting, walking, taking the stairs, and standing up can burn up to three times more calories than your hardest workout without spiking hunger hormones. title: The Coin That Costs 3 Cents To Make 🪙 #shorts #economics #money
description: Why the United States government loses tens of millions of dollars every year making pennies. #shorts #finance #economy #business
text: The United States government loses tens of millions of dollars every single year producing a coin nobody wants. It currently costs more than three cents to manufacture and distribute a single one-cent penny. In 2023 alone, the US Mint lost over ninety million dollars making pennies. Despite countries like Canada abolishing their penny years ago, political lobbying by zinc mining corporations keeps this massive money loser alive. title: You Have Never Tasted Real Wasabi 🍣 #shorts #food #sushi
description: Unless you've eaten at an elite sushi restaurant in Japan, 99% of the wasabi you've eaten is fake. #shorts #foodfacts #culinary #japan
text: Unless you have eaten at an elite sushi bar in Japan, you have probably never tasted real wasabi in your entire life. Authentic wasabi is one of the most difficult and expensive crops on Earth to cultivate, costing over one hundred and fifty dollars a pound. Because real grated wasabi loses its flavor within fifteen minutes, nearly every restaurant on Earth serves regular horseradish dyed green with food coloring.
